name: LoraxBench
intro: LoraxBench 是面向印尼语及 19 种印度尼西亚本地语言的综合基准，覆盖阅读理解、开放问答、自然语言推理、翻译、因果推理和文化问答六项任务。三种本地语言同时区分正式与日常语域，共形成 23 个语言/语域子集；数据由专业母语者翻译、第二位母语者复核，并经过长度与数字一致性自动检查。
build_method: 印尼语源任务改造, 专业母语者翻译, 第二母语者复核, 自动一致性检查
language: 印尼语及19种本地语言（23个语言/语域子集）
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 自然语言推理, 翻译, 分类
eval_feature: 多语言, 语域对比, 本土文化
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Natural Language Inference, Translation, Classification
build_method_en: Indonesian-source task adaptation, professional native-speaker translation, second-speaker review, automated consistency checks
intro_en: LoraxBench is a comprehensive benchmark for Indonesian and 19 regional Indonesian languages across reading comprehension, open-domain QA, natural language inference, translation, causal reasoning, and cultural QA. Formal and casual variants for three local languages yield 23 language/register subsets. Professional native speakers translate the data, second native speakers review it, and automated length and numeric-consistency checks flag corrections.
language_en: Indonesian and 19 local languages (23 language/register subsets)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Adapt six Indonesian-source tasks"] --> B["Clean source-specific items and define 23 language/register subsets"]
    B --> C["Translate with professional native speakers and review with a second speaker"]
    C --> D["Run length and numeric checks, then correct flagged translations"]
    D --> E["Release 87,011 rows, including 2,300 TyDi-QA training rows"]
    E --> F["Evaluate with task-specific accuracy and ChrF++"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.12459 and the official google/LoraxBench release. The diagram preserves the six source tasks, 20-language and 23-subset design, task-specific cleanup, professional native-speaker translation, second-speaker review, automated length/numeric checks, prompt variants, and task-specific metrics. It also records the source count discrepancy instead of silently collapsing it: paper Table 3 sums to 84,711 test items, the paper prose states 84,895, and the official release has 87,011 rows because it additionally includes 2,300 TyDi-QA training examples.
